Visibility: offer only when a scrap decision is RECORDED, i.e. selected_scrap_type is set, is NOT 'No Scrap', and is NOT the 'Scrap Type Required' placeholder. That placeholder is the workflow's fallback whenever nothing has been saved or a suggestion finds no match, so a stored placeholder means NO DECISION was made - not 'no scrap'. IMPORTANT: HasScrapDecision in SetupDunnageTypeViewModel is NOT this rule - it answers 'has the operator decided at all' and returns TRUE for 'No Scrap'. The visibility rule is HasScrapDecision AND value != 'No Scrap'. It also cannot be called from MTM_Waitlist.Settings at all, which has no reference to MTM_Waitlist.Setup, so the predicate must be lifted into MTM_Waitlist.Core (see tasks T023/T024/T029). 'No Scrap' is a real selectable option meaning the job has no scrap (SetupWorkflowService.NoScrapValue = 'No Scrap'), so a job that chose it has nothing to collect. Line 2 carries the job's scrap type. Picker options come from SetupWorkflowService.s_defaultScrapTypes, spelled exactly: '3003 Aluminum', '5052 aluminum' (lowercase a), 'Galvanized Steel' (not just 'Galvanized'), 'Steel', 'Skeleton', 'Gaylord', plus 'No Scrap'.
